declarations.objective: Classify one change request against the knowledge a repository already holds, returning a closed verdict of none, update, or create and naming every implicated knowledge object and ADR. Choose it at the impact-analysis phase, before anything is authored. Not for authoring, not for deciding the next phase, and not for judging whether the change is a good idea.

required_context.note: Classification reads what a change touches, not the whole ontology. A lifecycle, an interface, and a process are reached through the objects above rather than selected directly, so naming all six would narrow nothing.

deterministic_behavior: the result is validated against impact-analysis/1 at the boundary before anything consumes it
every knowledge-object and ADR identifier the result names is checked to resolve in the graph
the verdict is one of the closed set none, update, create, and no other value is accepted
judgment: which knowledge objects a change request semantically implicates
whether the implication amounts to none, an update, or a creation

grant.note: Read-only on purpose. A judgement that could also edit what it judges is not a judgement, and the boundary validator is not this agent's to run.

failure_outcomes.reason: a required input was not supplied, named in the result rather than substituted
an identifier the analysis would name does not resolve in the graph
the change request asks for two things that cannot both hold, named so a caller can decide
